headline: Regional Gerindra Chapters Endorse Sufmi Dasco For Vice President
seoTitle: Gerindra Chapters Support Sufmi Dasco for Vice President
metaDescription: Multiple Gerindra regional branches and coalition partners have expressed support for Sufmi Dasco Ahmad as the next Vice President of Indonesia.
aiSummaryBullets: Regional branches of the Gerindra party across several provinces have officially expressed their support for Sufmi Dasco Ahmad as the next Vice President.
Supporters cited Sufmi Dasco Ahmad's extensive political experience, loyalty to the party leadership, and ability to maintain national stability.
Zulkifli Hasan stated that coalition political parties have reached a consensus that the next Vice President should be a member of the Gerindra party.
aiContextParagraph: Following the vacancy of the Vice Presidential position, various regional boards of the Gerindra party, including those in Banten, Riau, West Kalimantan, East Java, and Southwest Papua, have declared their support for Sufmi Dasco Ahmad to assume the role. Supporters describe him as a seasoned and loyal political figure capable of ensuring national stability. Simultaneously, Zulkifli Hasan, the General Chairman of the National Mandate Party (PAN), indicated that political parties within the existing coalition have agreed to nominate a candidate from the Gerindra party to fill the vacancy. According to Hasan, the coalition partners have collectively decided not to propose their own internal party candidates for the position. This series of declarations has generated significant domestic media attention and public interest regarding the future leadership transition within the Indonesian government.
whyItIsViral: The story has achieved a high viral activity score due to rapid, multi-outlet coverage and a surge in public search interest regarding the potential successor to the Vice Presidency.
